name: Encrypted Letter
summary: Among the Syndicate papers, one letter cannot be read. You take it to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

sections.title: A Letter No One Can Read
sections.body: Among the Syndicate documents, one letter is written in a cipher no one can read. You bring it to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

sections.title: What Dibbs Makes of It
sections.body: Loremaster Dibbs has never seen this kind of cipher before. He still has much to learn before he can understand it.

faq.q: Where does the letter come from?
faq.answer: The letter is one of several on a table among the Syndicate documents, and its meaning is unreadable.

faq.q: Who is the letter taken to?
faq.answer: You take the letter to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.
